vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Zoom Client for Meetings on Windows contains an unquoted search path vulnerability that allows a local user to escalate privileges to SYSTEM.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Upgrade Zoom Client for Meetings to version 5.15.5 or later.

vulnerabilities.shortDescription: RARLAB WinRAR before 6.23 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code when a user attempts to view a benign file within a ZIP archive.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Upgrade WinRAR to version 6.23 or later.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Support Diagnostic Tool (MSDT) Remote Code Execution (Follina)
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: A remote code execution vulnerability exists when MSDT is called using the URL protocol from a calling application such as Microsoft Office Word.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply Microsoft official patches or disable the MSDT URL protocol.

vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Type confusion in V8 in Google Chrome prior to 114.0.5735.110 allowed a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Upgrade Google Chrome to version 114.0.5735.110 or later.

vulnerabilities.shortDescription: A remote code execution vulnerability exists in Microsoft Word due to memory corruption bugs.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Upgrade Microsoft Office/Word to the latest secure version.
